issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies the Farm.animals attribute as private (aggregation with '-' in the UML and the text asks for a getter and setter), but the solution declares the field as public (public List<Animal> animals). This visibility mismatch can confuse students about expected encapsulation and the need for a private attribute accessed via getter/setter, and may conflict with tests or grading that expect the attribute to be private.
issues.suggestedFix: Declare the animals attribute as private (private List<Animal> animals) in the Farm class to match the UML and the textual instructions. Keep the public getter and setter as specified. Update any code that directly accesses the public field to use the getter/setter instead.
